name: altar
description: Altar.Camp — artist signing & mission label platform. Know what you own. Know what you share. Know where the money goes.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @altar/api" "npm run dev -w @altar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @altar/api && npm run build -w @altar/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
